subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Demonstrar interesse ao ouvir histórias lidas ou contadas, observando ilustrações e os movimentos de leitura do adulto-leitor (modo de segurar o portador e de virar as páginas).

components.description_pt: Demonstrar interesse ao ouvir histórias lidas em voz alta ou contadas oralmente
components.description_en: Demonstrate interest while listening to stories read aloud or told orally
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate active listening and engagement during group read-alouds of literary texts

components.description_pt: Prestar atenção em ilustrações durante leitura em voz alta de história
components.description_en: Attend to illustrations during a story read-aloud
components.cc_component_description: Explain the relationship between a story's illustrations and its narrative events

components.description_pt: Observar comportamentos de leitura de adulto como segurar livro e virar páginas
components.description_en: Observe adult reading behaviors such as holding the book and turning pages

cc_matches.description: Actively engage in group reading activities with purpose and understanding.
With prompting and support, describe the relationship between illustrations and the story in which they appear (e.g., what moment in a story an illustration depicts).
